candidate.checkpoint_prediction_hashes: Bind actual terminal/export hashes before evaluating; do not alter the selected epoch

reference.role: own public-incumbent-lineage parent prediction; this is not the full public submission endpoint

split_manifest.exposure: exposed discovery fold; not fresh confirmation

comparison_design.mask: need_prediction AND is_scored; need_prediction is row index >= 99 in every sequence
comparison_design.metric_formula: For each target, clip target and prediction to [-2, 2], weight rows by abs(clipped target), pool all selected rows, compute weighted Pearson correlation; wp is the arithmetic mean of t0 and t1.
comparison_design.blend_formula: p=(1-alpha)*reference+alpha*H218 raw predictions, then official metric clipping
comparison_design.reporting_rule: Report the official score and delta from alpha=0 for every alpha; do not choose or promote the best weight.
comparison_design.pair_covariance_and_correlation: Per target clipped member predictions and original clipped-target magnitude weights on official scored/prediction mask

uncertainty.method: paired component bootstrap over frozen group-level official metric moments
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional on fixed predictions and exposed fold-0 components; excludes training-seed and public-transfer uncertainty.

comparability_limits: H218 is full-feature attention128x2 scratchseed7; reference is own GRU256x2seed3 with since teachers and propensity ancestry
Not a matched architecture or compute-controlled contrast; report conditional model/ensemble value
Fold0 is exposed discovery; no fresh-confirmation or public-transfer claim

interpretation: Positive uncertain effects can support bounded follow-up; confidence intervals are not universal kill rules. A weak standalone can have conditional value. No public/local additive forecast.
